# Robin Farrow

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired, plump boy with a round skull covered in fuzzy yellow ringlets, a snub nose, and a wide, smiling mouth. He has lively, roguish hazel eyes and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him an endearing, uneven look when he laughs. Over time he grows taller, eventually losing a front tooth to a door-string extraction.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c26 P18](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0018)_

## Personality

Robin is an energetic, inquisitive, and mischievous boy who frequently finds himself in trouble. He has an appetite for play, adventurous stories, and sweet food like jam and plum cake. Though prone to impish pranks and candid remarks, he is fundamentally affectionate and eager to be loved, particularly by Nell.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c8 P55](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0055), [v2 c10 P12](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0012), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c14 P16](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0016)_

## History

Following his mother Mary's terminal illness, Robin and his twin sister Lucy are brought to Grey Shutters to be raised by Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt. Upon arriving, he demonstrates an energetic, restless nature, quickly becoming fond of Nell while constantly getting into scrapes. Over time, he causes various domestic disruptions, such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church, pushing Lucy into a pigpen, placing a toad in Thirza's bed, and consuming restricted jam. He enters Brierley school alongside Lucy, where he competes in growth and antics with his classmate Milty Gammon. After his mother passes away and his uncle dies in British Columbia, a bequest secures money for his care. As he grows older, he continues living at Grey Shutters under Thirza's and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby's watch while remaining devoted to Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c27 P31](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0031), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c14 P16](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0016), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P12](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0012), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)_
